gaps.lead: I'd love to be able to afford a bigger flat.
gaps.explanation: wish + subject + could expresses regret about ability or possibility.

gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing = because of.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say X is… → X is said to be…
